title: skill-observation
description: Per-role observation schema for a SKILL.md file. Validated by linting-a-resource-file after envelope validation passes. Encodes the conformance rules from work/governance/rules/specifications/skill.md.

name.description: Kebab-case skill slug. First component is a transformer gerund; resolution of the gerund and noun phrase to substrate is enforced cross-file by resolving-a-skill-name, not by this schema.

description.description: R7: exactly two sentences on a single line. Sentence 1 names the change the skill causes; sentence 2 names when to use the skill and contains 'use' or 'when'. Semicolons forbidden in either sentence (would fuse the clauses). The negative-lookahead `(?!\.\s+[A-Z])` inside each sentence body forbids an internal sentence boundary, pinning the description to exactly two sentences.

bodySectionHeadings.description: Top-level '## ' headings in document order. The first three MUST be Requirements, Steps, Outcomes. Additional sections after Outcomes are permitted.

scriptRefs.description: Script paths referenced from ## Steps. Cross-file existence of each path is checked by resolving-a-skill-name, not by this schema.

frontmatter.name: making-a-skill
frontmatter.description: Creates a conformant skill directory at doing/working/hacking/doing/working/skills/<slug>/ with SKILL.md, _index.md, and any scripts subdirectory the body requires. Use when adding a new reusable procedure to the skill catalog.
